licenseTexts.unrar:
UnRAR License

The UnRAR sources may be used in any software to handle RAR archives
without limitations free of charge, but cannot be used to develop RAR
(WinRAR) compatible archiver and to re-create RAR compression algorithm,
which is proprietary. Distribution of modified UnRAR sources in separate
form or as a part of other software is permitted, provided that it is
clearly stated in the documentation and source comments that the code may
not be used to develop a RAR (WinRAR) compatible archiver.

This restriction does not affect Muse, which only extracts RAR archives
and does not implement RAR compression.

including any conditions on redistribution or combination with other code.
